name: Belief tag new (categorize untagged beliefs)
notes: Daily at 05:30 local — AFTER the belief_engine rebuild (00:30) and the feedback_extractor drain (04:00-05:00), so the night's new beliefs from both producers get tagged before morning. Tags active beliefs with no belief_tags yet, from the standardized vocab (configs/belief_tags.yaml). only_untagged is a shrinking selector so the pass converges; capped at max_per_run with max_run_seconds as the watchdog. on_error.auto_retry_after_seconds self-heals a transient failure (DB lock / LLM hiccup).
